commits.headline: feat(port/rac1): widen a mod's menu pages to fit their texts
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
A mod page of the game's widgets copies the Options page's frames (first level) and the Language
page's (second level), sized for the game's short labels, so longer titles wrapped and scrolled,
list lines wrapped and footers dropped to the small font. A widget's box is its frame moby's
projected frame, posed by its seq and placed by the moby's rows; the menu camera looks along z
with the world's axes, so the screen's x is the world's.

mod_ui stretches a mod page's title, list and footer frames…

commits.headline: fix(port/rac1-ntsc): bind moby updates to the US class update table (#93)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
The warm savestate change (12342e62) runs assign_moby_class_data as host C
(rac1/host/moby_class.c), written against PAL's addresses and mapped per
version through RAC1_ADDR. For the US build it mapped PAL's update table
(0x1B3900, resident_moby_class_data) to 0x1B3900 as well, but the US
decomp's update table is D_001B3580: the three slot tables (resources,
updates, class ids) are each 0x380 lower than PAL's, and the US 0x1B3900
is the s16 class ids register_moby_class writes.

So every…

commits.headline: fix(port): a skipped frame drops its effect texture notes too (#95)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
When the port skips a frame to catch up, it cleared the tick's effect
quads and their uploads but kept effect_texture_ids, the notes
effect_quad makes for quads with an 8-bit texture and a CLUT of their
own. The next frame's effect_textures() read them against the new
tick's quads: an index past the list, a garbage upload index and a
SIGSEGV in clut_csm1 (rac1-ntsc on Android, loading a save on Oltanis).

The skip clears effect_texture_ids, effect_hashed and effect_sources
with the quads, and…

commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
SpaceFlightUpdate's state 3 (the ship flying off from the planet) sets the
camera through the executable's empty hook stubs func_001E9770 (set-up from

commits.headline: fix(rac1): a movie plays in the game's language (#98)
commits.author: mateuszklysz
commits.body:
Movie_Play's last argument is the audio channel initAll picks, and the
game passes its language there (infobots, story movies). The port's
replacement always asked for channel 0, so every movie played in English.
